    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    try {
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"documents\":[\"doc1\"],\"model\":\"nonexistent-rerank\",\"query\":\"test\"}", RerankRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.rerank(req)
    } catch (error: Exception) {

}
